evals.prompt: Our SwiftUI product list is fast after first load, but inventory can change every minute. Review the URLSession repository and choose a cache policy that still works in airplane mode without letting stale stock authorize checkout.
evals.expected_output: Separates browse-time stale product data from checkout-time authoritative inventory, reuses HTTP validators, scopes policy to the repository, and defines offline/failure behavior and deterministic tests.

evals.prompt: Make this Android Compose messaging repository truly offline-first. Users can send and delete messages on two devices, duplicate sync workers sometimes run, and an old page occasionally overwrites a newer refresh.
evals.expected_output: Uses the local database as read source of truth, durable mutation IDs/tombstones/cursors, unique WorkManager sync, bounded retry and conflict rules, plus generation/version protection against stale overwrites.

evals.prompt: Audit caching in a Flutter and React Native app where users see another account's localized dashboard after switching accounts. The cache key is currently just the URL and refresh fires on every screen focus.
evals.expected_output: Finds the key-isolation root cause, covers account/tenant/locale and query identity, cancels in-flight work on account switch, replaces focus refresh storms with an explicit freshness policy, and tests cross-account leakage.
